description: MAINTENANCE WORK ORDER, built and held off: the holder signs a plan for recurring upkeep at one place, ties its needs to jobs the holder posted on the board, renews it for the next cycle, or withdraws it. It is a record only: it binds no one, nothing is held, sent or paid, no job is posted by it, and you can spend the NET or withdraw the plan at any time. The plan carries a NET figure for the cycles ahead (a house reference, not a price), and the door checks it against your wallet's fresh NET balance less the NET the wallet has already named in other records. The work itself is posted, claimed, proven and accepted on the board by other people, and the door never links work that needs a permit or a licensed person. You name one act: plan (the place in plain words and its pin, who speaks for it, 1 to 12 needs, how many cycles and how long each is, and when the first is due), link (tie one need in the active cycle to a job you posted on the board with this same wallet), renew (open the next cycle, on your own fresh signature, if the board's own record lets it), or withdraw (end the plan). No job links to any place until a wallet the operator lists as a site-authority verifier has put the evidence it saw on file, public ground too: the kind of place is your own word until then, and with no verifier listed nobody can. A renewal waits for the board to show one job linked to the cycle accepted by a wallet with no known link to the plan's parties; no check says that wallet is a person. FREE to sign, no fee, no gas. The program is built but held off until the operator switches it on: until then a plan, a link or a renewal is refused before you sign, with the same answer whatever you send, and a withdrawal only works on a work order that exists. What depends on this wallet or on the board is answered only when you submit, so prepare never says whether a wallet holds a work order: the cap of five open work orders for one wallet, whether the wallet's balance covers the plan (a balance that cannot be read is refused there too), an id already in use with other terms, and every refusal of a link or a renewal (no authority on record for the place, a cycle that is not open, a need that is blocked, not due or already linked, a job the board does not show or that you did not post, a renewal the board's record does not yet allow). If one applies, nothing is recorded, and each is refused after the signature is verified, so each spends the signature: read net_work_order_status first. Prepare refuses only what is true for every wallet or shown by the keyless read of the same work order: a body that breaks the door's rules, a house wallet, a work order that does not exist, and one that was withdrawn. This moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through these tools. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the holder wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_work_order within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

cycle.description: link: the cycle this job is for, 0 to 11. Cycle 0 is the active one until you renew.

cycleDays.description: plan: days in each cycle, 7 to 365.

fromCycle.description: renew: the cycle you are renewing from, 0 to 11, the one now active.

needId.description: link: the id of the need this job answers.

needs.description: plan: 1 to 12 needs, each { id (lowercase-dashes), objective (plain words, 5 to 300 characters), everyCycles (1 to 12) }. A need carries no conditionId here.

place.description: plan: { name, lat, lng }, the place in plain words (never a street address) and its pin. A keyless read never shows the name or the pin: it shows only a 350 metre cell, and only for public ground a listed verifier has confirmed, so a private place, and public ground no verifier has confirmed, is not shown at all. Your own signed reply shows the name you gave and the 350 metre cell.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet that holds the work order. Address only, never a private key.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters. Only you ever read it back.

siteAuthority.description: plan: { kind: public_ground | owner | manager | association, evidenceRef }. A private place needs the evidence reference (a deed, a parcel, a minute). The kind is your own word until a listed verifier wallet puts its evidence on file.

startAt.description: plan: when the first cycle is due, an ISO time.

workId.description: link: the job's id on the board. You must have posted it with this same wallet.

workOrderId.description: The work order's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you plan; the same id and the same terms read the work order back.

name: prepare_net_work_order
title: Plan recurring upkeep for one place, link a job to a need, renew, or withdraw: the maintenance work order (step 1 of 2)
